debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-t u-p m-i-s-l-e-a-d-i-n-g b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s a-n-d p-o-s-t-e-d o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-i-e-s t-o c-r-e-a-t-e a p-l-a-u-s-i-b-l-e p-a-p-e-r t-r-a-i-l w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e n-e-e-d-e-d t-h-i-r-d-p-a-r-t-y a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-r-o-v-i-d-e-d s-f-i-g-h-t-e-d p-e-r-m-i-t r-e-p-r-o-d-u-c-t-i-o-n-s t-o b-u-y-e-r-s w-h-i-l-e l-e-f-t t-h-e o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l r-e-c-o-r-d-s a-b-s-e-n-t f-r-o-m t-h-e f-i-l-e.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-c-l-o-s-e-d w-i-l-d-c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d s-t-a-t-u-s a-s "c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-d" i-n a-d v-e-r-t-i-s-e-m-e-n-t-s w-h-i-l-e i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y l-a-b-e-l-i-n-g r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e-d m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e s-a-l-e t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n-s w-h-i-l-e d-e-l-i-b-e-r-a-t-e-l-y a-v-o-i-d-i-n-g o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e-s.
